node.statement: By def-maincb-raw-call, form the Stage-3 raw-call record with the two supplied reset states/maps, the named finite-dimensional source and explicit target A_R, pre-helper scale t_3, the four-corner datum scale rho, the derived literal output level-one map and its fixed amplifications (not the four-corner datum itself as a map), target ambient record epsilon_R:=W.L*epsilon, and its recorded raw defect. Nodes 1.2--1.5 show that every Stage-3 prerequisite and every datum error is absorbed by t_3 and that rho <= C_cross^0*t_3. Since the instance was arbitrary, the universal implication and hence node 1 follow.
